title: What happened to regular handles?
text:
What happened to regular handles?. I have an older version of this, and it is great!

It has a REGULAR handle, so it is easy to carry.

This version doesn't have a regular handle.

Ridiculous design!

1-1/2-quart size perfect for whisking eggs or salad dressings, 3-quart size designed for use with electric mixers, 5-quart size ideal for tossing salads or serving popcorn
description: The OXO Good Grips 3-Piece Mixing Bowl Set helps you tackle any culinary project, from whisking eggs to mixing cupcake batter to making marinades. The 1.5-quart, 3-quart and 5-quart Bowls feature soft, easy-grip handles. Non-skid bottoms stabilize the Bowls on any kitchen surface, even when tilted. Wide lips and spouts make pouring ingredients easier. Plus the Mixing Bowls nest neatly for convenient storage. Available in blue, green and yellow with black handles; white with blue, green and brown handles; and white with black handles. BPA free and dishwasher safe.
